thread:
maria: Snyk reported a base64-encoded GCP service account JSON in services/partner-bridge/Dockerfile. looks like a full key blob in ENV. suspect confirmed leak, want rotation ASAP.

jordan: can you paste file path + the blob or decoded client_email privately? infra needs client_email or key id to revoke. :eyes: 

maria: file path: services/partner-bridge/Dockerfile
maria: snippet: ```
ENV PARTNER_SA_KEY_B64=eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9...<truncated>
```
maria: no key id visible, it's the whole json base64. attaching snyk output.

sean: ack, i'll decode the blob to extract client_email locally. pls DM the blob (don't paste public channel). once i have client_email i'll list keys and delete the exposed one.

ben: immediate plan: (1) revoke exposed key, (2) create replacement with least privilege, (3) update Vault entries / rewrap ciphertexts that referenced the key, (4) scrub repo history for the commit, (5) run org-wide secrets-sleuth scan and quarantine any matches. also recommend moving to workload identity or workload federation to avoid long-lived keys.

maria: DM'd decoded json to sean: client_email=partner-bridge-sa@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com

sean: running quick commands:
```bash
gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=partner-bridge-sa@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com --format=json
# identify exposed KEY_ID then
gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete KEY_ID --iam-account=partner-bridge-sa@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```
sean: deleted key (id ends with -X9z). creating a new key with narrow roles.
sean: creating replacement: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys create /tmp/partner-bridge-new-key.json --iam-account=partner-bridge-sa@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com`

maria: thanks. checklist for vault/platform: which Vault secrets used that SA? partner-bridge config used the SA to access partner bucket and to wrap/unwarp objects via CloudKMS. we need to rotate those secrets and rewrap any ciphertexts that were created using old KEK.

ben: platform will: (a) enumerate Vault paths referenced by partner-bridge (mounts, apps roles), (b) read stored ciphertexts and check if they were wrapped with KMS key resource `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/partner/cryptoKeys/bridge-key`, (c) if so, run rewrap flow: decrypt with old KEK in a secure job (ephemeral), re-encrypt with target KEK or new wrapping key, and write back. will also bump secret version metadata.

vault-bot: audit: enabled file audit at /var/log/vault_audit_partner-bridge.log by ben at 3267890200

jordan: RBAC hardening suggestion: remove broad roles (storage.admin) from the SA. grant minimal perms: storage.objects.get/list on the specific bucket, and kms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter scoped to the exact key resource. add IAM condition limiting usage to the partner-bridge service account + deploy service identity. consider short-lived tokens via Workload Identity Federation instead of JSON keys.

maria: i'll open a PR to remove the blob, replace with a Vault reference and update CI to read secret from Vault at deploy time. also going to coordinate git history rewrite in case the key existed in earlier commits. planning to use git-filter-repo to purge: `git filter-repo --invert-paths --path services/partner-bridge/Dockerfile --replace-refs delete-no-add` followed by forced push to protected branch with manager approval.

sean: infra post-rotation checklist i ran:
- revoke old key ✅
- issue new key and store in Vault as partner/bridge/sa-key:v2 ✅
- update partner-bridge deployment env to pull from Vault template ✅
- smoke test: app can list/read bucket objects and KMS unwrap works ✅

ben: running an org-wide secrets-sleuth with pattern detection for base64 JSON SA blobs and typical key filename patterns: `tools/secrets-sleuth --org=redwood --pattern=GCP_SA_JSON_BASE64`. initial pass found 1 historical match in legacy/deploy-legacy branch. DM'd owner to rotate and will scrub. ETA for full sweep: 20m.

maria: opening incident INFSEC-2042 to track timeline and evidence for compliance. assigning owners: sean (infra) -> revoke/replace + smoke tests, ben (platform) -> vault rewrap + audit log consolidation, maria (sec eng) -> repo scrub + compliance package. adding links to gcloud audit logs and Vault audit file to ticket.

compliance-bot: noted. request: attach GCP admin activity logs showing key deletion, Vault audit file, and git commit SHAs for scrubbed branches. retention window required: 1 year.

ben: scan update: found ancillary usage in an old deploy job config in repo `ops/legacy-deploy`; flagged and opened PR to remove. will run `git filter-repo` on a per-branch basis and coordinate with team leads before force pushes.

maria: summary for audit: leaked key detected by Snyk -> secret decoded -> key revoked -> new key created and stored in Vault -> app updated to fetch secret from Vault -> Vault audit enabled for partner-bridge -> repo scrub PR opened -> org scan in progress -> INFSEC-2042 created. will attach evidence and close when compliance signs off. locking this thread for further sensitive details. :lock: 

sean: no infra blockers. if platform needs temporary access to rewrap job, request a short-lived ephemeral role and i'll grant 1-hour access via IAM.

maria: thanks team :thumbsup:
